subject.title: Telegram /reasoning stream can leave replies stuck after send_attempt_started and chat.history burst

question: Should this issue remain the canonical combined Telegram `/reasoning stream` plus `chat.history` recovery report, or should maintainers fold the ambiguous-send part into the broader Telegram guarded-lane work and split the UI history pressure separately?
rationale: The source evidence confirms a shared ambiguous-send recovery gap, but this report adds a reasoning-preview trigger and Control UI history pressure that the existing broader Telegram issue and PR do not fully own.

options.title: Track Distinct Combined Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

options.title: Fold Telegram Recovery Into Broader Issue
options.body: Treat the send recovery signature as covered by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91456 and preserve this issue only as linked evidence there.

options.title: Split UI History Pressure
options.body: Track Telegram ambiguous-send recovery through the broader Telegram issue and open or select a separate Control UI/Gateway item if the history burst is confirmed independently.

recommendation.title: Track Distinct Combined Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical place to prove and fix the reasoning preview/final delivery path and decide whether `chat.history` needs backpressure or debouncing.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent history cover the shared recovery guard, Telegram adapter capability block, and related Telegram/outbound surfaces where this decision would be enforced.
